# Command timing catalogue

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask bench-commands` from crates/engine/examples/bench_commands.rs. Don't edit by hand. -->

> **Generated** for Cella 0.13.0 at `d8e1542` (2026-11-23). Machine: windows x86_64. Method, the two scales and what a row does not measure: [performance.md](performance.md).

**One row per registered command.** The scenario gate (`cargo xtask perf`) prices the operations a session spends its seconds on; this prices the command surface, so that no command is a blank. A cell is the command's own wall clock in ms on a workbook of that many rows × 6 value columns, run alone in a fresh session (a table, a chart, a defined name, a clipboard block and one undo step are in place; see the example's `prepare`).

| scale | the parameters the command is given |
|---|---|
| `small` | near the cursor, the fuzzer's params: "what does it cost when the user points it at a few cells" |
| `whole` | its region-naming params (`range`, `target`, `criteria`, …) cover the whole used area: "select the column and format it" |

A command that names no region has the same cost at both scales — that is a fact about the command, not a missing measurement. A note says how the row went: `params` or `refused` means the command turned the generated params down (no cost was observed), `no` means it ran and the answer was no (nothing found, no such table), `no change` means an edit that changed nothing, and `PANIC` would mean a caught panic. `-` means that configuration was not measured at all.

## No number yet, and what the command said

Every row of these commands was refused or errored, so the table above carries a failure time, not a cost. Most want an object this workbook does not carry (a PivotTable, a script, a control); the rest want params the generator cannot shape. Turning them into numbers is the catalogue's next job, and `xtask/bench-coverage.txt` records each one as excused until it is done.

| command | what it said |
|---|---|
| `file.exportParquet` | missing `path` |
| `home.formatCells` | invalid type: string "B20:D22", expected struct Style |
| `object.format` | `font` must be a typeface name |
| `pageLayout.themeColors` | unknown theme `theme name` |
| `data.query.add` | source.kind is missing |
| `data.query.addStep` | step is not a QueryStep: invalid type: integer `2`, expected string or map |

| `chart.setDataLabels` | give either `point` or `deletePoint`/`showPoint` |

| `data.solverReport` | `reports` must be an array of answer, sensitivity and limits |

## Not measured, and why

A command that opens or closes a document, reads or writes a file or switches windows cannot run in a throwaway session. Each is an `excuse:` line in [../xtask/bench-coverage.txt](../xtask/bench-coverage.txt).

| command | why |
|---|---|
| `file.new` | opens another document |
| `file.open` | opens another document (reads a file) |
| `file.close` | closes the document under test |
| `file.save` | writes files |
| `file.saveAs` | writes files |
| `file.exportCsv` | writes files |
| `file.exportHtml` | writes files |
| `file.exportPdf` | renders and writes a PDF |
| `file.print` | renders a PDF (the print path is `file.print`'s own benchmarks) |
| `insert.picture` | reads files |
| `pageLayout.background` | reads files |
| `window.activate` | switches windows |
| `view.newWindow` | adds a window |
| `view.closeWindow` | closes a window, and with the last one the document under test |
| `macro.debug` | holds an undo group open across calls |
